purpose: Understand Brilliant boundaries and validate better Mute classification with300 additional labeled moves.

quantity.quota_fallback: Aim30/class/account. If an account exhausts eligible unseen-game reserves, fill remaining class slots in fixed order KNVB,GothamChess,Hikaru,nelsi,hansen. Preserve every rejected/reclassified candidate as secondary evidence; do not replace based on local classifier predictions.

selection.positives: Existing visible one-year sacrifice-gallery candidate order, exclude every prior explicitly reviewed game and known development/regression position; round-robin sacrifice categories where available. No more than one chosen positive for the same before-position+move across different games.
selection.negative_controls: Explicitly selected same-player moves in those new games. Prefer raw-v2 apparent legal offers, then quiet attacked/defended pieces, then recapture/exchanges, other captures and other quiet moves; nearest ply first, then ply. Missinggallerymembership is unknown, not negative. A control displaying Brilliant is secondary and systematically replaced.
selection.historical_vs_current: Gallery labels kept separate from observed current review displays; changed labels retained secondary.
selection.partitions: Whole-game SHA256("mute-extra300:"+gameID) integer modulo3==0 reserved validation; remainder discovery. The rule author receives discovery data only until candidate source is frozen. Collectors necessarily see all visible labels.
selection.known_positions: Exclude normalized first4FENfields from earlier study primary and known-regression-fens; record any repeated positions and cross-partition overlap.
selection.tuning: Existing v2,v3,EC frozen before new labels. No application changes; any new candidate chosen on discovery only must be source-frozen before reserved-game scoring.

evidence.coach: Read visible innerText only. Wait for hidden typewriter spans to disappear with a bound; otherwise retain partial_or_unverified. Never fill missing explanations.

resources.scale_up: At system pressure1/normal with adequate free memory and no sustained swap growth, addthirdcollector.
resources.scale_down: Pressure2/warning: no new navigations, checkpoint and reduce toone; pressure4/critical: checkpoint/close ownedresearchtabs. Nevercloseuser tabs or restartapp.
resources.checkpoint: Persist every observed move; monitor pressure/swap/process RSS at collector batch boundaries.

engine_plan_after_collection.windows: preceding,before,after, actual prior complete iterations; same policy and source parity checks.
engine_plan_after_collection.stronger: Atmost30frozenhash-selecteddisagreements at1500000nodes, before reporting any stronger changes; do not mix them into baseline.
